summary: Full e2e testing of Arxeon Elite 2.0 landing. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (root health, consultation POST valid/invalid/missing-fields, persistence GET). Frontend: 17/17 UI assertions pass (hero IT/FR titles, 3 tier cards with Donapp, 5 orbit nodes, 13 pillars, 4 strategy points, header & hero CTAs anchor to #contact, language switch IT<->FR updates content, no 'Donna 2.0' string in IT or FR, form validations for empty + invalid email, successful submission persists to MongoDB).

minor.issue: In server.py, `logger.exception(...)` inside the except block references the `logger` global that is defined LATER in the file (after `app.include_router`). If MongoDB ever raises, this branch will fail with NameError and mask the real DB error. Move logger initialisation above the route definitions OR replace with `logging.getLogger(__name__).exception(...)`.

issues: Hero title words are wrapped in inline-block spans with margin-right but no actual whitespace text node. This is purely visual (renders correctly) but breaks any DOM tooling/assistive tech that reads `textContent` -- it returns 'L'Aziendachesigestiscedasola.'. Consider inserting a literal space or aria-label on the h1.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Fix the forward-reference of `logger` in /app/backend/server.py — move logging config above the route definitions so the except branch in create_consultation works correctly.
(Optional A11y) Add aria-label or a real space between hero-title word spans so screen readers and `textContent` get correct spacing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` referenced before assignment inside POST /api/consultation exception handler — latent bug on DB failure.
Frontend correctly uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via /api prefix.
All interactive elements have data-testid coverage as required.
MongoDB _id properly excluded in list endpoint via projection {'_id': 0}.
Pydantic EmailStr + min_length validation provides 422 on bad input.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth on this app.
seed_data_creation: Test consultation records prefixed with TEST_ and unique e2e_<timestamp>@example.com emails were inserted via the public POST /api/consultation endpoint during testing. Not cleaned up (no DELETE endpoint exists; main agent can purge from the `consultations` collection if desired).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero title spans render visually-spaced via CSS margin but `textContent` collapses to a single concatenated string. Always normalize whitespace (e.g. `''.join(text.split())`) when asserting on hero-title. The contact form has data-testid: form-company, form-email, form-phone, form-submit, form-success, error-company, error-email, error-phone. Backend POST /api/consultation accepts {company,email,phone,tier,language,message} and returns 200 with id + created_at. There is no DELETE endpoint.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found that blocked the required features. The only observed code smell is the forward-reference of `logger` in server.py's exception path — this is dormant and only triggers if pymongo raises during insert_one; if it does trigger the user would receive a 500 with an obscured root cause due to NameError raised inside the handler.
